name: Thomas Marino
bio: a Representative from Pennsylvania; born in Williamsport, Lycoming County, Pa., August 15, 1952; graduated from Williamsport Area High School, Williamsport, Pa., 1970; A.A., Williamsport Area Community College, Williamsport, Pa., 1983; B.A., Lycoming College, Williamsport, Pa., 1985; J.D., Dickinson School of Law, Carlisle, Pa., 1988; manufacturing manager; lawyer, private practice; Lycoming County, Pa., district attorney, 1992-2002; United States attorney for the Middle District of Pennsylvania, 2002-2007; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Twelfth and to the four succeeding Congresses until his resignation on January 23, 2019 (January 3, 2011-January 23, 2019).
